candidate.repair: collect every gate/up-ready lease before launching the first prefix Metal kernel

panic.panic_string: watchdog timeout: no checkins from watchdogd in 93 seconds
panic.interpretation: The benchmark Metal command-queue thread was blocked in IOGPUFamily and AGXG17X for the same interval that watchdogd stopped checking in. This is a GPU command-queue hang, not an SSD-bandwidth or compressor-pressure panic.

environment.advisory_relevance: Apple reports that 26.5.2 fixes an IOGPUFamily race condition where an app may cause unexpected system termination.

remaining_software_hazard.description: begin_split_route submits persistent miss reads before HotExpertSwitchGLU evaluates persistent hits. Component-bank rows share one Metal buffer per projection, so a CPU reader can write one row while a GPU kernel reads another row of the same resource.
remaining_software_hazard.scope: pre-existing component-bank hit/miss overlap; not unique to PR #18

decision.next_gate: Update to macOS 26.5.2 or newer, preserve the PR as open, and separately remove or isolate same-bank CPU-write/GPU-read overlap before any bounded-to-sustained promotion.
decision.reason: The projection-prefix ordering repair passed through 1,024 bounded tokens but did not prevent a second GPU-driver watchdog panic. The installed OS is missing an IOGPUFamily race fix that directly matches the blocked driver stack, while MTPLX also retains an independently unsafe same-resource overlap.
